g.text: B.E. AI & ML - Sri Krishna College of Technology
Final-year AI and Machine Learning engineering student at Sri Krishna College of Technology, Coimbatore,
focused on agentic AI, LLM reasoning, and model efficiency. Builds production-grade RAG pipelines,
fine-tunes and quantizes open models on free-tier GPUs, and distills reasoning traces from large models into
small ones. Current research track covers model calibration, reasoning distillation, and vectorless
retrieval, aimed at a final-year publication.
Built PlantDocBot, an end-to-end plant disease diagnosis system combining computer
Fine-tuned CNNs (ResNet, MobileNet) on PlantVillage and PlantDoc, gaining a 15 percent
Trained a BERT symptom classifier and deployed the full system with Streamlit.
Sensitivity-aware mixed-precision quantization on Qwen2.5-0.5B; FFN layers found
Perplexity 21.34 vs 22.94 for uniform INT4, at 61 percent lower latency than INT8.
170-item benchmark testing whether Qwen2.5 models know when they are wrong.
Logistic probe on hidden states reached AUROC 0.79, cutting overconfidence on
Distilled Claude Fable-5 reasoning traces into Qwen3-4B via QLoRA SFT on 4,659
agentic sessions, training only 0.80 percent of parameters.
55 percent training loss reduction (1.957 to 0.878) over 583 steps, ~3GB VRAM.
LangGraph, Groq, NVIDIA NIM, PyMuPDF, Chainlit
Vectorless multi-paper RAG parsing PDFs into hierarchical section trees, replacing
4-node LangGraph agent delivers cited, page-referenced answers across 5 papers.
Hybrid GraphRAG and Agentic RAG over 30-50 research papers, combining knowledge
graphs with dense retrieval for multi-hop reasoning through a Chainlit UI.
4 specialised agents across 7 tools deliver Proceed/Pause/Roll-Back decisions in
17.84s avg latency, cutting analyst effort ~90 percent at ~$0.02/run.
